title: titanodendron schumanniana

It is a medicinal plant traditionally used in various parts of the world, particularly in the Amazon region, for its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of Titanodendron schumanniana, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
